implementationPlan.description: Implement complete canonical-delta validation in budget-account-replay.ts. Open the root once; iterate every group without filtering; treat empty groups as the explicit no-op; require the first nonempty group to equal the opened state's entire ROOT_OPENED entry list and mark root consumed; refuse any later ROOT_OPENED or an end-of-input with no root. On any transition refusal pass it through; on success compare the exact appended suffix to the whole supplied group by count/order and all seven fields, refusing via `refuseMalformedBudgetReplay` on any difference, then advance state. Return the already deeply frozen live-transition state; never delete, normalize, sort, or append caller entries directly.
